segments.text:
We will now have a look
at the Schematic Navigator.

Open the Navigator panel
by clicking the Panels button
and select Navigator.

Click on any document name
in the Navigator panel

to see nets and components
just for that page.

You can expand the arrow
beside the document name
to see the other sheets in the project.

Click on the Flattened Hierarchy
to see the nets and components
for all schematics in the project.
With the Flattened Hierarchy tab selected
search for the component R9
in the list of components to jump to it.

It's possible to highlight nets globally
across the entire design.
Zoom out from R9

and left-click anywhere in the schematic
to clear the highlight.
While holding the ‘Alt’ key,

left-click on the ground net
below component R9.

Now you can see the ground nets
are highlighted in the design.

They will also be highlighted across
every schematic sheet in the project.
Hit ‘Shift + C’
or left-click anywhere in the design

to clear any selection, highlights,
or dimming.

This concludes our video,
on the Schematic Navigator panel.

title: Altium Training - Navigating Schematics: Schematic Navigator
